rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physical breaking into pieces or disintegration.

example.english: The fragmentation of the glass left shards all over the floor.
example.traditional: 呢塊玻璃一跌落地就碎裂，成地都係碎片。
example.jyutping: ne1 faai3 bo1 lei4 jat1 dit3 lok6 dei6 zau6 seoi3 lit6 sing4 dei6 dou1 hai6 seoi3 pin2

rows.note: Use this for the breakup or disintegration of an organization, system, or larger structure rather than for pieces physically shattering.

example.english: The fragmentation of the alliance was caused by deep internal disagreements.
example.traditional: 呢個聯盟內部分歧太大，最後終於解體。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 lyun4 mang4 noi6 bou6 fan1 kei4 taai3 daai6 zeoi3 hau6 zung1 jyu1 gaai2 tai2

rows.note: Use this specifically when describing bomb fragments scattering in all directions.

example.english: The bomb's fragmentation scattered in all directions, so everyone ducked.
example.traditional: 炸彈一爆，彈片四散，大家即刻伏低。
example.jyutping: zaa3 daan2 jat1 baau3 daan6 pin3 sei3 saan3 daai6 gaa1 zik1 hak1 fuk6 dai1
